title: Calibration-Preserving Pruning: Compression as a Reliability Contract
abstract: arXiv:2608.23744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Split conformal prediction, not the pruning rule, supplies finite-sample marginal coverage once a pruned model is fixed independently of the conformal calibration split. We study the separate efficiency problem: can pruning preserve score geometry well enough to obtain smaller valid prediction sets? Calibration-Preserving Pruning (CPP) augments a base pruning score with nonconformity-gradient saliency and uses disjoint pruning, validation-selection, conformal-calibration, and test splits. Bounded score perturbations imply bounded conformal-quantile shifts and controlled set inflation, but do not make the generic coverage theorem CPP-specific. translated_title: 校准保持剪枝：压缩作为可靠性契约
translated_abstract: 分裂共形预测，而非剪枝规则，在剪枝模型独立于共形校准分割固定后，提供有限样本边际覆盖率。我们研究独立的效率问题：剪枝能否充分保持分数几何结构，以获得更小的有效预测集？校准保持剪枝（CPP）通过非共形梯度显著性增强基础剪枝分数，并使用独立的剪枝、验证选择、共形校准和测试分割。有界分数扰动意味着有界共形分位数偏移和受控的集合膨胀，但这并不使通用覆盖定理具有CPP特异性。最终在50%稀疏度下使用五个种子的Qwen2.5-1.5B结果显示，在大标签任务上收益最大。在DBpedia-14上，CPP-SparseGPT将平均集合大小从10.1降至8.6，同时准确率从0.347变为0.366；CPP-Wanda将11.2降至9.0，准确率权衡从...
tldr: 本文提出校准保持剪枝方法，通过增强剪枝分数保持分数几何结构，在保证共形预测覆盖的同时减小预测集大小，实现更高效的模型压缩。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Calibration-Preserving Pruning, which enhances pruning scores to preserve score geometry, reducing prediction set sizes while maintaining conformal coverage for more efficient model compression.
